do_not_use_when: A simple supplied Gaussian measurement model: use measurement.
A request-prescribed closed-form statistic: use prescribed-statistic.

examples.phrase: Synthetic example: a three-bin spectrum with prediction-dependent covariance and destructive interference.

use_when: A measured differential spectrum with full covariance must be compared with signal terms.
Interference terms, profiled nuisances, scans or toy limits are needed on a binned spectrum.
